notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for standard handle encoding and decoding across dimension, region, and message-retraction services. The source uses only the official IEEE 1516.1 C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, DDM FOM, endpoint, logical-time implementation, and callback configuration. It verifies cross-federate handle stability, encoded length, direct-buffer and VariableLengthData round trips, copied-handle value semantics, truncated-buffer errors, region metadata, timestamped updates, and retraction without asserting provider-specific behavior.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador dimension and region metadata, handle encode/decode, timestamped update, and message-retraction services with standard discovery callbacks
api_surfaces.source_symbol: IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador handle, DDM, time-management, and object-management declarations
